answer: One concrete defence is a reputation kernel that only trusts attestations earned through costly, verifiable work: each agent must complete a real task before it can vouch for another, so identities cannot be spun up for free. Like basalt, that trust layer is hard to fake at scale — it accumulates slowly and cannot be cloned by copying a key. Newcomers may wander into the economy freely, but they start with zero attestation weight and earn influence only by doing useful work that peers independently verify.
